plans.title: Plans and pricing
plans.text: Ledgerfox offers three plans. Starter costs $12 per month and includes 1 user and up to 50 invoices per month. Growth costs $29 per month and includes up to 5 users and unlimited invoices. Scale costs $79 per month and includes up to 25 users, unlimited invoices, API access and single sign-on (SSO). Paying annually gives a 20% discount on any plan.

trial.title: Free trial
trial.text: Every new workspace starts with a 14-day free trial of the Growth plan. No credit card is required to start the trial. When the trial ends the workspace switches to read-only mode until a plan is chosen.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.text: Annual plans can be refunded in full within 30 days of purchase. Monthly plans are not refunded, but downgrading gives a prorated credit on the next invoice. Approved refunds reach the original payment method in 5 to 7 business days. Refund requests for a specific account must be opened with the create_refund_request tool.

invoicing.title: Invoices, reminders, late fees and taxes
invoicing.text: Late fees can be enabled per client, up to 1.5% per month on the overdue balance. Automatic reminders are sent 3, 7 and 14 days after the due date. Invoices can be issued in 32 currencies. Each line item can carry up to 3 tax rates, which covers VAT and GST setups.

payments.title: Ledgerfox Payments
payments.text: Ledgerfox Payments accepts cards and bank transfers through Stripe and PayPal. Card payments cost 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. Payouts arrive in your bank account 2 business days after the payment clears.

export.title: Data export and retention
export.text: You can export clients, invoices and payments as CSV or PDF from Settings > Data. Full workspace exports are emailed within 24 hours. Records are retained for 7 years to meet bookkeeping requirements.

api.title: API and webhooks
api.text: The REST API is available on the Scale plan only. The rate limit is 120 requests per minute per workspace. Failed webhook deliveries are retried 5 times over 24 hours with exponential backoff.

security.title: Security and data residency
security.text: Two-factor authentication is available on all plans. Single sign-on (SSO) with SAML is included in the Scale plan. Customer data is stored in Frankfurt (EU region) or Virginia (US region), chosen when the workspace is created. Ledgerfox holds a SOC 2 Type II report.

account.title: Deleting a workspace
account.text: The workspace owner can delete the workspace from Settings > Account. Deleted data is permanently purged after 30 days; until then it can be restored by contacting support. Ownership can be transferred to any admin.

support.title: Support and disputes
support.text: Chat support is available 24/5, Monday to Friday. Email requests are answered within 1 business day. Phone support is included in the Scale plan. Payment disputes and chargebacks are handled by the payments team: the assistant must escalate them with the escalate_to_human tool.

mobile.title: Mobile app
mobile.text: The Ledgerfox mobile app runs on iOS and Android. It scans receipts with on-device OCR and works offline for up to 7 days, syncing when the connection returns.

invoice_lookup.title: Questions about a specific invoice
invoice_lookup.text: Questions about the status of a specific invoice (for example INV-12345) must be answered by calling the lookup_invoice tool with the invoice ID. The assistant has no other access to invoice data.
